title: Depositing `UniV3PoolHelper` only once per block for all users
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  `checkLastBlockAction` allows only one deposit for a given `msg.sender`.  ```solidity 	modifier checkLastBlockAction() { 		if (_callerLastBlockAction[msg.sender] == block.number) revert UniV3TokenizedLp_NoDepositOrWithdrawLoop(); 		_; 		_callerLastBlockAction[msg.sender] = block.number; ```  In fact, it means that `UniV3PoolHelper` can only deposit once per block, for all `UniV3PoolHelper` users (and thus all LockZap users). This condition may be too strict resulting in reverts for users in the block if `UniV3PoolHelper`
